title: Hilton Amalfi Coast
world_prompt: The Amalfi Coast in Italy on a bright summer morning. Pastel houses stacked up a steep cliff above a turquoise bay, lemon trees on terraces, small wooden boats in the harbour, a winding coastal road. Cinematic travel film, warm golden light, slow graceful camera.

beats.scene: A slow, wide establishing shot of the pastel town on the cliff above the turquoise bay in morning light.

beats.line: Mornings start slowly here. Lemon groves, sea air, coffee on a terrace.
beats.scene: The camera drifts along a terrace of lemon trees, sunlight through the leaves, the sea glittering below.

beats.line: By noon, the coast road is calling. Every bend, a new view.
beats.scene: The camera follows the narrow coastal road as it curves around the cliff, the bay opening up below.

beats.line: Afternoons belong to the water. Take a boat, find your own cove.
beats.scene: A small wooden boat glides across calm turquoise water toward a hidden cove under the cliffs.

beats.line: And every evening, you come home to Hilton, right above the bay.
beats.scene: An elegant cliffside hotel terrace with an infinity pool overlooking the bay, warm late-afternoon light.

beats.line: Hilton Amalfi Coast. Seven nights from twenty-four fifty. And if you're wondering about anything, just ask me.
beats.scene: The camera rises slowly over the hotel, the harbour and the whole town in golden light.

facts.hotel: Hilton Amalfi Coast: a 74-room cliffside resort above Positano, built into a restored 1920s villa, with terraced gardens down to the water.
facts.price: The seven-night package is from 2,450 US dollars per person: flights from New York, a sea-view room, daily breakfast, airport transfers and a private boat day to Capri.
facts.shorter_stays: Three nights from 1,290 dollars per person, five nights from 1,850 — both with flights from New York, a sea-view room, breakfast and the airport transfer. The boat day can be added for 180 dollars.
facts.hotel_only: Rooms alone are from 340 dollars a night for a sea-view king, breakfast included. Suites with a private terrace are from 690.
facts.transport: Yes. A private driver meets you at Naples airport and drives you along the coast road to the hotel, and back at the end — included. Ferries link Positano, Amalfi and Capri from the beach below, and the hotel shuttle runs into town every 30 minutes. A private driver for day trips is 95 dollars a day.
facts.beach: The hotel has its own beach club on Spiaggia Grande, a four-minute walk down the garden steps or a two-minute ride in the cliff elevator. Loungers and umbrellas are free for guests.
facts.pool: An infinity pool on the main terrace, heated from April to October, plus a quieter adults-only pool in the lemon garden.
facts.spa: The Grotta Spa is carved into the rock: a sea-water plunge pool, a steam cave and lemon-and-sea-salt massages. Fifty minutes from 160 dollars.
facts.dining: Three restaurants: Terra, the rooftop for long seafood dinners; Limone, the garden trattoria for handmade pasta; and the beach club for lunch. Breakfast runs 7 to 11, with sfogliatelle baked every morning.
facts.bar: The Terrace Bar is famous for its sunset limoncello spritz, with live piano on Friday and Saturday nights.
facts.night: Evenings are slow: dinner on the rooftop at Terra, the harbour lights below, then a stroll through Positano's lanes for gelato.
facts.food: Fresh seafood, lemon everything, handmade pasta, and a weekly cooking class in the lemon garden where you make scialatielli with the chef.
facts.dates: Packages depart every Saturday from April to October. June and September are the sweet spot: warm sea, fewer crowds.
facts.weather: Summer is 27 to 31 degrees Celsius and sunny; the sea is about 25. Spring and autumn are mild, around 20 to 24.
facts.rooms: Every room faces the sea. Sea-view kings and twins, terrace suites, and the two-bedroom Villa Suite with its own plunge pool.
facts.kids: Families are welcome: the Piccoli kids' club runs 9 to 6 for ages 4 to 12, with pizza-making and boat-spotting. Cots and high chairs are free.
facts.accessibility: Positano is famously steep, but the hotel has two cliff elevators and step-free routes to the pool, restaurants and beach club.
facts.pets: Small dogs are welcome for 40 dollars a night, with a bed and bowl in the room.
facts.honors: Hilton Honors members earn points on the whole package and get a free room upgrade when available, late checkout until 2, and free Wi-Fi.
facts.checkin: Check-in from 3, check-out by 11. Early arrivals can use the beach club and showers while the room is readied.
facts.wifi: Fast free Wi-Fi everywhere, including the beach club.
facts.activities: Boat day to Capri and the Blue Grotto, the Path of the Gods hike at sunrise, a Ravello concert evening, kayaking to Fornillo beach, and a limoncello tasting.
facts.weddings: The terrace hosts weddings for up to 80 guests, with ceremonies at sunset.
facts.booking: Book at hilton dot com slash amalfi, or say 'book it' and we'll send the details to your phone. Free cancellation up to 30 days before arrival.
facts.insurance_and_extras: Lunches and dinners are not included, except the cooking class. Travel insurance is extra.
facts.currency_and_language: Italy uses the euro; the hotel team speaks English, Italian, Spanish and French.
facts.local_tip: Ask the concierge for Da Vincenzo's stuffed peppers, and take the 6 p.m. ferry back from Amalfi — the light on the cliffs is the best of the day.
